top_paper.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
top_paper.summary: Semantic task completion video generation evaluates whether generated videos achieve intended outcomes with semantic grounding, supported by a curated dataset and vision-language model-based benchmark.

papers.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.summary: A human-aligned chain-of-thought reward model and preference dataset improve joint video-audio generation by replacing fragmented metrics with coherent, dimension-wise reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Evaluating Music Context Preservation: A Multi-facet Framework for Music Editing Systems
papers.summary: The study introduces MuseCPEval, a framework with tailored metrics to evaluate preservation of unchanged musical attributes during editing tasks.

papers.title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
papers.summary: RapidLiDAR learns adaptive spatial displacements to initialize LiDAR scenes and refines them via multi-scale voxel and BEV features for real-time completion.

papers.title: SPK: Eliciting Structured Prior Knowledge for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection in Real-Time Object Detection
papers.summary: Structured Prior Knowledge explicitly extracts latent semantic, geometric, and contextual priors from pretrained object detectors to detect out-of-distribution hallucinations via a compact interpretable representation.

papers.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
papers.summary: HOTFIXR is a data generation framework that targets multilingual reasoning weaknesses to improve cross-lingual performance without sacrificing overall capability.

papers.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
papers.summary: The Agentic Principal Chain enforces session-aware authorization checks to prevent harmful action combinations and delegation abuses in LLM agents.

papers.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary: SkillGate fixes selector credit starvation in agent skill selection by separating outcome credit for execution tokens from local advantage for skill-naming tokens, improving success rates and reducing misleading skill exposure.

papers.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning
papers.summary: AdaPop adapts gradient pressure by fact popularity and automates forget-retain balance to reduce leakage of unlearned content.

papers.title: Temporal Multi-Signal Fusion for Token-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.summary: Hallucination is detected as temporally extended spans via sequence labeling over fused external features, achieving robust cross-model performance without internal model access.

papers.title: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
papers.summary: Co-RL enables unsupervised reasoning via cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with peer-derived rewards, improving performance across text and vision tasks without ground-truth labels.

papers.title: Scaling Creative Writing Beyond Story-Centric Data with Attribute-Guided Genre Expansion
papers.summary: A framework that separates thematic seeds from genre-form controls generates diverse, high-quality creative writing data across 13 genres and improves LLM creative writing performance.

papers.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
papers.summary: OmniScientist is an end-to-end omni-modal AI scientist that performs multidisciplinary research directly from heterogeneous raw evidence using autonomous agents and lifecycle-wide perception, improving evidence-grounded discovery across diverse scientific modalities.

papers.title: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.summary: Zetta is a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves runtime critics and recovery skills online to govern physical execution at action frequency, achieving high success on robot benchmarks with faster inference and scaling self-exploration.

papers.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
papers.summary: Action-conditioned objectives improve latent geometry for Euclidean-cost model-predictive control by enhancing decision-metric alignment in world models.

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
papers.summary: SoftVTBench introduces a synchronized visuo-tactile dataset and deformation-aware benchmark for evaluating physical interaction quality during deformable-object manipulation.

papers.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
papers.summary: Semantic task completion video generation evaluates whether generated videos achieve intended outcomes with semantic grounding, supported by a curated dataset and vision-language model-based benchmark.

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.summary: Compatible open-weight language model checkpoints share detectable weight-space ancestry signals that distinguish true lineage from independent or distilled models without requiring data.

papers.title: Training Chemical Plausibility-Aware Large Language Models for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.summary: Top-K prompting and plausibility-aware training improve diverse reaction prediction in single-step retrosynthesis, yielding state-of-the-art results on a large verified reaction dataset and motivating ensemble systems.

papers.title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
papers.summary: SemaPLC is a verification-gated agent harness that validates generated PLC logic through external compilation and live runtime execution, achieving higher verified pass rates than baseline methods.

papers.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
papers.summary: SPADE is a self-play reinforcement learning framework where a language model designs adaptive executable training environments and learns to solve them, improving reasoning and tool-use performance through regret-based environment targeting.

papers.title: Looped Language Models Improve Compositional Tool Calling
papers.summary: Looped language models improve compositional, multi-step tool use through recurrent computation, with adaptive inference balancing accuracy and compute cost.

papers.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
papers.summary: FM-Bench evaluates long-horizon decision-making of LLM agents managing a football club over 20 years, revealing that managerial behavior rather than scale or token spend drives performance.

papers.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
papers.summary: SkillForge improves automated software issue resolution by synthesizing repository-specific issues and distilling reusable skills from them before encountering real bugs.

papers.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery
papers.summary: A literature-to-review pipeline automates problem discovery and triage to focus expert review on promising mathematical conjectures within a chosen research direction.

papers.title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents
papers.summary: LEGO-RL connects native coding-agent harnesses to scalable policy-gradient training via in-process LLM proxying, sandbox orchestration, and integrated monitoring, improving sparse MoE model performance across multiple harnesses.

papers.title: PTXBench: Benchmark and Adapt LLMs for GPU Kernel Optimization with Architecture-specific PTX
papers.summary: PTXBench evaluates large language models on architecture-specific GPU kernel optimization, revealing uneven success and performance gaps that supervised fine-tuning only partially addresses.

papers.title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
papers.summary: CardioState-JEPA learns a unified cardiac representation across ECG, PPG, and PCG by predicting masked latent physiological states with cross-modal delay alignment, improving downstream classification across all three modalities.

papers.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
papers.summary: V-RAE constructs semantically organized video latents from frozen vision representations to improve generation quality, convergence speed, and predictive modeling.

papers.title: DiSCO: Defending text-to-image generation through distribution-guided contrastive prompt optimization
papers.summary: DiSCO is a black-box, zero-shot prompt-level defense that uses distribution-guided suffix expansion and contrastive scoring to reduce harmful image generation without altering the model.

papers.title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
papers.summary: PixRestore is a compact, VAE-free pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch for unified image restoration, using flow matching on patchified pixels, DINO-based reliability-guided feature fusion, and adversarial fine-tuning to a one-step generator for efficient high-fidelity inference.
